// Every change to a row arrives here as { update }: write only those columns, matched on row_number.
return $input.all().filter(it => it.json && it.json.update).map(it => ({ json: it.json.update }));

parameters.content:
## Seedance 2.5 videos on your PixVerse plan, from a Google Sheet

### How it works
For creators and agencies who make many AI videos on a PixVerse plan they already pay for, with the [useapi.net PixVerse API](https://useapi.net/docs/api-pixverse-v2?utm_source=n8n.io&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=pixverse-sheet-batch), a third-party API, not affiliated with PixVerse. One plan, many models: the `model` column picks Seedance 2.5, PixVerse v6, Kling 4.0, Veo 3.1 or MiniMax H3 per row.

1. Each row is one video: a prompt, an optional `image_url` (image-to-video), and optional model, quality, duration and aspect ratio. A form adds many prompts at once.
2. Every 3 minutes the workflow checks each new row against the [model's limits](https://useapi.net/docs/api-pixverse-v2/model-capabilities?utm_source=n8n.io&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=pixverse-sheet-batch), starts it on an account with a free job slot, and saves the `video_id` at once.
3. It then reads the running videos, and writes the link, status and an optional Google Drive copy back to the row.

Busy accounts wait for the next tick. Refused or invalid rows get `error` and a note. A start that may have used credits is never resent: `check job`.

### Setup
- [ ] A [useapi.net subscription ($15/month) and API token](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi?utm_source=n8n.io&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=pixverse-sheet-batch), and your own PixVerse plan [connected there](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-pixverse?utm_source=n8n.io&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=pixverse-sheet-batch).
- [ ] A Header Auth credential (Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <token>`) on the useapi.net HTTP nodes.
- [ ] Google Sheets and Drive credentials, and `sheetId` in **Settings**.
- [ ] A tab with these columns in row 1: `prompt`, `image_url`, `model`, `quality`, `duration`, `aspect_ratio`, `email`, `status`, `account`, `video_id`, `started`, `finished`, `video_url`, `drive_link`, `note`.
- [ ] A Basic Auth credential on the form, then publish the workflow.

### Customization
**Settings** holds the default model, quality and duration, the per-tick limits and the Drive folder. Set a row's `status` to `new` to run it again.

## Start
A form or a 3-minute schedule. **Settings** holds the sheet id and every default.

## Add prompts from the form
One prompt per line, `prompt | image link` for image-to-video. Each line becomes a `new` row.

## Plan the tick
Free reads of your accounts, their free job slots and the sheet. Each new row is checked against its model's limits.

## Image rows
The image is fetched and uploaded to PixVerse, then used as the first frame. A failure here costs nothing.

## Start the video
The paid call: the row's model makes the video and its id is saved at once. It is never retried by n8n.

## Read the running videos
A video still being made writes nothing. Moderated or failed ones get an error note.

## Save to Google Drive
Optional: downloads the finished mp4 and uploads it to your Drive folder.

## Write back
One update per row, matched on its row number: status, links and notes.
